Name: BluejaySkie's Kids' Portraits Redraw
Author: BluejaySkie
Description:
[color=#f4cccc][size=3][b][Planning Explanation]:
[/b][/size][/color][size=2] As for Jas's and Vincent's sprites, I only have the sprites for the outfits that I have changed/recolored. All the other outfits are the same as the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod sprites. All the sprites I have used for my changed/recolored outfits came from that mod. If you have any question or concerns, please don't hesitate to ask me. That is all, thank you.[/size]


[color=#93c47d][size=4][b][Introduction]:[/b][/size][/color]
Hello, I'm an artist trying to practice my pixel art skills. :)

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b][Explanation]:[/b][/size][/color]
For a while now, I have wanted to change Jas's portraits into something more appealing to me. So, I edited her lips and that was it. Until I got bored and decided to change her whole portrait. Then, I went to change Vincent's and Leo's portraits. After that, I went to change the Ridgeside Village kids' portraits because I wanted consistency in children's portraits always being front facing. Finally, I decided to create a mod for the portraits, so it can be simpler for me to change them and for anyone else who is interested in my mod.

[b][color=#ffd966][size=4][Inspirations]:[/size][/color][/b]
My inspiration for making this mod came from creators such as nyapu ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]) with their amazing facial and hand expressions, as well as creators such as starrybonns ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11568]Alternate Portraits for Stardew Kids Expansion at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]) with their adorable alternative versions of SKE kids created by BURAKMESE and illustrated by Huongle265 from ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]Stardew Kids Expansion at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]). I wanted to give the kids fun hand and facial expressions but also keep it vanilla style.

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b][Future Plans]:[/b][/size][/color]
Redraw other kids from different mods.

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b][Configuration and Added Features]:[/b][/size][/color]
1.) Enable or Disable portraits and sprites.
2.) No nose feature for the SDV kids.
3.) A 2nd costume for the SDV kids with dialogue to go with them.

[b][size=4][Download]:[/size][/b]
1.) Make sure to install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher. 
2.) Make sure you install any of the required and/or optional requirements.
3.) Unzip the folder and put it in your mods folder.
4.) And you're done. Thank you for Downloading! ;)
